privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.whoText: PetApp is a pet health management platform operated by Franco Coria, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Contact email:
privacy.dataIntro: When you use PetApp we collect:
privacy.dataItem1: Identity data: email, full name, phone (optional), city (optional)
privacy.dataItem2: Your pets' data: name, species, breed, date of birth, weight, color, microchip, photos, allergies, vaccines, medications, medical history
privacy.dataItem4: Technical data: IP address, operating system, app version
privacy.useIntro: We use your data exclusively to:
privacy.useItem1: Provide the service (show you your pet's profile, etc.)
privacy.useItem2: Enable the link with veterinarians when you authorize it
privacy.useItem3: Send you notifications related to your pet's health
privacy.useItem4: Improve the service (aggregated statistics, without identifying you)
privacy.useNoSell: We do not sell your data to third parties. Ever.
privacy.accessItem2: The veterinarians you granted access to (you can revoke it whenever you want)
privacy.accessItem4: Our technical providers (Supabase, Vercel, Resend) under confidentiality agreements
privacy.rightsItem1: Access all the data we hold about you
privacy.rightsItem3: Delete your account and all associated data
privacy.rightsItem4: Export your complete history in PDF or JSON
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise these rights, write to us at
privacy.storageText: Data is stored on Supabase servers (AWS, US-West region) with encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest. Photos are in private buckets with signed URLs that expire.
privacy.childrenText: PetApp is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you discover that a minor created an account, contact us to delete it.
privacy.changesText: If we make significant changes we'll notify you by email and in the app before they take effect.

dataDeletion.metaDescription: How to delete your PetApp account and associated data, from the app or by requesting it via email.
dataDeletion.title: Delete your account and data
dataDeletion.intro: You have two ways to delete your PetApp account. Both permanently erase your profile, all your pets, vaccines, allergies, medications, tests, veterinarian accesses, subscriptions and any medical history associated with your account. The action is irreversible and cannot be undone.
dataDeletion.option1Step1: Sign in at <link>pet-friendly.fun</link> or in the app installed on your phone.
dataDeletion.option1Step3: Scroll to the bottom → red card "Delete my account".
dataDeletion.option1Step5: In less than 30 seconds your account and all data are deleted.
dataDeletion.option2Text1: If you lost access to your account or have a technical issue, send us an email at <link>{email}</link> from the email associated with your PetApp account.
dataDeletion.option2Text2: Include in the subject: PetApp account deletion
dataDeletion.option2Text3: We reply within 72 hours and process the deletion in less than 7 business days. We confirm by email when it's done.
dataDeletion.deletedItem1: Personal profile (name, email, phone, photo, city)
dataDeletion.deletedItem2: All your pets and their complete history
dataDeletion.deletedItem4: Weights, photos, tests and medical consultations
dataDeletion.deletedItem6: Premium subscriptions (vet) — if you have one active, it's automatically canceled when the account is deleted
dataDeletion.keptIntro: For legal and basic security requirements, we keep some anonymized or aggregated data after deletion:
dataDeletion.keptItem1: Anonymized security logs (90 days) — to detect abuse.
dataDeletion.keptItem2: Medical records created by a veterinarian about your pet — kept by the professional according to applicable legislation (typically 5 years for the veterinarian's own protection). These remain in the vet's account, with no identifiable link to you as the owner.
dataDeletion.rightsText: You can also request an exportable copy of your data (in JSON format) before deletion. Request it by email at <link>{email}</link>.
dataDeletion.inAppFastDesc: Your account stops existing within seconds.
dataDeletion.byEmailSlow: By email: up to 7 business days

terms.metaDescription: Terms of use for the PetApp service.
terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.section1Text: By creating an account or using PetApp you accept these terms. If you don't agree, don't use the service. We may update these terms in the future and, if we do, we'll notify you by email or within the app.
terms.section2Text1: PetApp is a web and mobile platform that allows pet owners to store their health history (vaccines, weight, allergies, tests, medications), share it with veterinarians via a QR code, and activate a public page in case the animal is lost.
terms.section2Text2: The service includes a free plan for owners and free and premium plans for veterinarians. The features of each plan are described in the app.
terms.section3Item1: You are responsible for keeping access to your email secure.
terms.section3Item2: We do not impersonate you: if someone gains access to your mailbox, they can enter your account and see your pets' history.
terms.section3Item3: You can close your account whenever you want from Settings. When you close it, we delete your personal data and your pets' data within the following 30 days, except what we are required to keep by legal obligation.
terms.section4Text1: Veterinarians must verify their professional license with a photo of the credential to display a "verified" badge to owners. Verification is manual and can take up to 72 hours.
terms.section4Text2: A veterinarian's access to an animal's history requires the owner's explicit approval (QR scan + confirmation click). The owner can revoke access at any time from the "Accesses" section.
terms.section5Text1: PetApp is a tool to record and share health information. It does not replace the veterinarian. Vaccination recommendations, reminders and alerts are estimates based on data entered by the owner and/or the veterinarian; they are not medical advice.
terms.section5Text2: In any animal health emergency, contact a licensed veterinarian.
terms.section6Text1: When you activate lost mode, we generate a public URL with the photo, name, contact details and last location of your pet. This URL is accessible by anyone who receives it. You decide what data to include and who to share it with.
terms.section6Text2: When you mark the pet as found, the URL stops working immediately.
terms.section7Text: You may not use PetApp to upload false information, sell animals, spam, violate the privacy of others, or for illegal purposes. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.
terms.section8Text: PetApp is offered "as is" without warranties of uninterrupted availability or absence of errors. We are not responsible for data loss arising from causes beyond our control, nor for medical decisions made based on the information entered into the platform.
terms.section9Text: If you have questions, write to us at <link>hola@pet-friendly.fun</link>.
